review_notes: Reviewed all declarations and proofs in the 172-line target, the imported spectral-image and frame-completion definitions, and downstream uses of the support lemmas. The retained-frame existence theorem depends on real positive-definite normalization and real orthonormal completion, so I found no justified generalization for that theorem. The support-only cross-Gram identity is algebraic and its proof has no such dependency.

findings.excerpt:
(V : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℝ) (W : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hV : ∀ i, g i ≠ a → ∀ j, V i j = 0)
    (hW : ∀ i, g i ≠ b → ∀ j, W i j = 0) : V.transpose * W = 0 := by
findings.problem: This support-only identity specializes its matrix entries to ℝ even though the proof only expands the product and makes each summand zero using disjoint supports. It requires no order, positivity, or division.
findings.proposed_change: Generalize the statement to `{α : Type*} [Semiring α]`, use `V : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) α` and `W : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) α`, and state the same support hypotheses and conclusion over α. The existing proof strategy applies: split on `g k = a`; in the first case `hab` implies `g k ≠ b`, and in the other case `hV` makes the summand zero. This also handles empty index types without extra assumptions. Do not generalize `cavityRetainedFrame_exists` on this basis; it uses real positive definiteness and orthonormal completion.
findings.benefit: Makes the reusable disjoint-support cross-Gram fact available for matrices over other semirings, rather than only real matrices. This identity is used to establish orthogonality between retained frames in several downstream constructions.
